name: Sightstrike
description: Seats the stock hard into the shoulder, lays the sight on the mark and squeezes the trigger so the ball flies true.

name: Firm Rifling
description: Drives the patched ball down the bore with three even ramrod strokes so the next shot leaves the muzzle true.

name: Raised Muzzlebrake
description: Swings the long barrel across the body to turn aside a thrust or cut aimed at the chest.

name: Hard Buttpad
description: Drives the iron butt-plate into an enemy's ribs or jaw once he has closed inside the barrel's reach.

name: Backward Chamber
description: Backs away with a short turn of the hips while the muzzle stays on the enemy and a pace of ground is gained.

name: Level Bipod
description: Lays the forestock on a fence rail or post and breathes slowly until the sight stops trembling.

name: Quick Magazine
description: Tears the paper cartridge with the teeth and pours powder and ball down the bore in one unbroken motion.

name: Scopedrop
description: Wraps the ball in greased cloth and starts it into the rifling with the heel of the hand so it grips the grooves.

name: Stepping Cheekrest
description: Cocks the lock while stepping forward on the off foot so the rifle is ready the instant the foot lands.

name: Planted Rearsight
description: Drops behind a low wall with the muzzle held down so that only the head and hands show to return fire.

name: Breathdash
description: Winds the sling tight about the forearm so the rifle sits firm and recoil spreads through the whole arm.

name: Boltbump
description: Sinks to one knee and props the left elbow on the raised knee to fire a steadier shot than standing allows.

name: Sudden Reticle
description: Whips the rifle up from the carry as the hips turn and fires the instant the sight crosses the target.

name: Wide Scopemount
description: Swings the stock in a flat arc at knee or hip height to knock a rushing enemy off balance.

name: Straight Muzzlebrake
description: Drives the fixed bayonet forward from the hip with both hands, the whole body behind the point.

name: Angled Bolt
description: Holds the rifle crosswise at chest height and shoves an incoming blade or club out to the side.

name: Bipodpace
description: Pulls forward on elbows and knees with the rifle cradled across the forearms so no part of the body rises above grass height.

name: Fouling Chamber
description: Fires and steps sideways out of the cloud so the enemy aims at the place where the shooter stood.

name: Sightdash
description: Sits the front bead in the rear notch with the mark balanced on top and fires on the half breath.

name: Breathhit
description: Stops the lungs at the bottom of an exhale and presses the trigger slowly through the pause.

name: Judging Rearsight
description: Flips up the rear leaf to the notch that matches the judged distance before the shot is taken.

name: Stiff Cheekrest
description: Plants the rear heel and leans into the stock so recoil rocks the body but never moves the feet.

name: Zerobump
description: Catches the muzzle as it lifts after the shot and drops it back on the target before the smoke thins.

name: Scopetrot
description: Advances in measured strides while counting each one so the distance to the target is known at every halt.

name: Level Magazine
description: Fires from the standing position with the left hand cupped under the barrel and the right elbow level with the shoulder.

name: Single Bipod
description: Tucks the left elbow beneath the rifle so bone rather than muscle carries its weight through a long aim.

name: Zerostrike
description: Brings the carried rifle to the shoulder in one pull and fires before the enemy has finished raising his own.

name: Downward Rifling
description: Grips the barrel with both hands and swings the heavy stock overhead down onto an enemy's head or shoulder.

name: Hitching Bolt
description: Hooks the bayonet over an enemy's weapon and twists the barrel so his arm is pulled wide of the shooter's body.

name: Resting Chamber
description: Slaps an incoming spear or blade away with the flat of the forestock and steps off its line.

name: Boltdodge
description: Skips backward two quick paces while pouring powder so that loading finishes beyond the enemy's first rush.

name: Boltdash
description: Leans past a corner or wall edge just far enough to bring the muzzle to bear and then ducks back.

name: Sightbump
description: Runs a thin thread of qi through both forearms so the sight rests motionless as the trigger breaks.

name: Sharp Zero
description: Passes qi down the loading arm so each seating stroke drives the ball home with even force and little effort.

name: Tight Buttpad
description: Lifts the stock with a pulse of qi in the wrists to beat a cut aside before it reaches the shoulder.

name: Skipping Longshot
description: Pushes qi into the thighs for three fast strides to the next patch of cover with the rifle held close.

name: Turning Scopemount
description: Angles the muzzle as it fires so its flash is thrown into the enemy's eyes and spoils his aim for a breath.

name: Blunt Cheekrest
description: Slams the butt-plate forward with a short qi-backed shove that bruises ribs and drives the enemy off.

name: Watching Bipod
description: Reads the distance to a marked stake or tree and sets the rear sight to match before the order to fire.

name: Upward Rearsight
description: Raises the rear leaf one notch for a long shot and holds a hand's width over the mark.

name: Calm Muzzlebrake
description: Tilts the hat brim and the angle of the head to keep a low sun off the sights.

name: Scopehit
description: Pumps qi through the arms in time with powder, patch and ramrod so reloading flows without a stumbling pause.

name: Low Buttpad
description: Whips the butt in a low arc across the shins of an enemy who has slipped inside the muzzle.

name: Nimble Magazine
description: Slides the bayonet onto the muzzle at a run without breaking stride or lowering the eyes from the foe.

name: Even Chamber
description: Watches drifting smoke and bending grass and shifts the aim sideways to meet the push on the ball.

name: Zerodrop
description: Holds the sight a finger's breadth to the drift side of the mark so the ball is carried back onto it.

name: Breathdrop
description: Aims at the edge of the mark nearest the breeze, trusting the push to bring the ball to the centre.

name: Measured Scopemount
description: Runs a thumb along the rear leaf to confirm its notch before firing into a changing breeze.

name: Shifting Bipod
description: Steps back once after a shot to clear the smoke from the sight line and settle the stance anew.

name: Snug Rearsight
description: Flicks the muzzle sharply into a lunging blade so the point is knocked wide and the lunger checks himself.

name: Wide Rifling
description: Presses the patched ball firmly into the lands and grooves so the spin it takes is clean and even.

name: Boltstrike
description: Runs a damp wiper down the bore between shots to lift the fouling that jams a tight rifled ball.

name: Quick Chamber
description: Jabs the bayonet at an enemy's stomach with a short wrist snap and pulls it back to guard at once.

name: Stout Cheekrest
description: Lines the barrel along the top edge of cover so only the muzzle and one eye are exposed to the enemy.

name: Solid Muzzlebrake
description: Presents the broad flat of the barrel and stock to an overhead cut and braces the legs beneath the shock.

name: Swaying Zero
description: Slides sideways in short even steps while keeping the rifle level so the enemy line must turn to follow.

name: Catching Buttpad
description: Fires a charged shot into damp ground to raise a smoke bank and falls back behind it unseen.

name: Sharp Longshot
description: Judges how the rifling's twist pulls the ball sideways at long range and aims off to meet that drift.

name: Forward Buttpad
description: Lies flat with the sling looped about the forearm to fire a motionless shot from the lowest possible position.

name: Sightamble
description: Rolls and crawls from one hollow to the next with the rifle clasped to the chest and its lock kept clear of dirt.

name: Sighthit
description: Rests the forestock on a knapsack or log and lets the qi in the shoulders settle until the aim is dead still.

name: Bipodhit
description: Rolls onto one side to load below the sight line of the enemy and rolls back to prone ready to fire.

name: Tripping Rifling
description: Kicks a spray of dust and gravel toward an enemy's eyes to cover a crawl to better ground.

name: Lowered Chamber
description: Lifts the rifle across the body as the knees drive upright so a foe rushing the prone shooter meets the barrel.

name: Square Zero
description: Fires on the count of a held breath, never earlier or later, so every ball leaves at the same point of the stance.

name: Stiff Longshot
description: Loads and fires at a steady pace toward an enemy's cover, keeping his head down without chasing a kill.

name: Scopehop
description: Rolls the shoulders as the feet slide back so that the rifle is lowered and the loading begins already in motion.

name: Descending Reticle
description: Gathers qi in the trigger finger and the first joint of the hand, letting the press arrive without a flinch.

name: Hooding Magazine
description: Plants the rifle's butt on the ground and holds the long barrel upright before the body as a narrow screen against glancing cuts.

name: Easing Squeeze
description: Fires once from a halt and drops back a step behind the next rank in a single smooth shift.

name: Light Bolt
description: Lowers the hammer to half cock and carries the rifle at the trail while advancing so no shot goes off by accident.
